subject.title: feat(minimax): route /fast to MiniMax's faster paid lanes with correct pricing

question: Should MiniMax-M3 `/fast` opt into MiniMax’s paid `service_tier: "priority"` lane, or should this PR be narrowed to the M2.7 highspeed accounting correction?
rationale: The branch deliberately adds an M3 behavior and cost policy, while the supplied related open issue asks for M3 to remain unchanged under fast mode. This cannot be resolved safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow to M2.7 repair
options.body: Retain the demonstrated M2.7 highspeed model-and-cost correction and defer the M3 product contract to the canonical pricing discussion.

options.title: Approve M3 fast lane
options.body: Adopt `/fast` as an opt-in MiniMax priority-tier contract and require catalog-compatible pricing and upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Narrow to M2.7 repair
recommendation.body: Retain the demonstrated M2.7 highspeed model-and-cost correction and defer the M3 product contract to the canonical pricing discussion.
